content: Ase qurppe
Ta ishuntho, yi nu bonchcho Goda Yesuus Kiristtoosa ammaniza maaqqiko, as aafe bi7ii as bonchchippatte.
Aazisos, worqqe miggiddo aathii, lo77o afila ma7eez dure as yi shiiqayid ye7eeza. Ma curqqa afila ma7eez manqqo asikka ye7eeza.
Lo77o afila ma7eez atha yi aathii bonchchii, «Ne yhannee lo77iza oyidatil bettoba» gi, ma manqqo atha, «Ne ezayid eqqoba woy yhannee ta toke lanqqatte sa7a bettoba» yi yeegiza.
Yeezin, yinttii, yi gancce shaako medhdheezittannee iita qofar yez daynnitay garkk baasanee?
Ta siiqo ishuntho, si7oytta. Ammanor dure maaqqad garkk fana qadhdhizitayis immad geez salo kaatetithii laattodgarkk yha sa7all yeezii manqqita Xoossay doorekasanee?
Zin yi manqqita toochchiza. Yinttan ciiphichizitayinnee pirdde keeth goochizitay durita baasanee? Yinttan daynna tiina goochchizitay unttan baasanee?
Yi xeegintteez bonchcho suntha cazhizitay unttan baasanee?
Zin Geeshsha Maxaafayid, «As ubba nena ne qadhdhizay garkk qadhdhoba» ginttinttii xaafintteez Xooss kaatetith higga yi poliko lo77o baz oothiza.
Zin yi as aafe bi7ii bonchchiko, nagara oothiza, ma higgay yinttan higge mentheez as garkk pirddoda.
Oonkka Xooss higge ubbapp petta ashshii, atteezita ubba naagiko ubbana mentheezay garkk taybinttiza.
«Laammippe» geez Goday, ma «Wodhippe» geeza. Zin neenii laamekka attii wodhdheez maaqqiko, higge mentheeza.
Wallo kessiza higge tiina pirdde ekkodayis yez as garkk odinttoyttanne oothoytta.
As maaroowa oonakka Xoossii pirddoda maarotith bayth pridoda. Maaqqozin maarotithi pirdda gamiza.
Ammanonnee ooso
Ta ishuntho, yinttipp pettii asii taasi ammano yeza gi, fa ammano oosor beezekka attiko eza ab maaddodee? E ammanay eza ashshodayis danda7inee?
Aazisos pettii ishay woy pettii mishita kallotikonnee unttis miizibaz dhabiko,
yinttipp pettii asii unttiko, «Saro yhanigoytta! Yinttan ho77o! Mi mizhoytta!» gi, koshshiza baz unttis inggekka attiko unttan ab maaddee?
Yey gishos, ooso baa ammano fa aaddas yhayqqo.
Zin pettii asii, «Nees ammano yeza; ma taas ooso yeza. Ne ne ammana ne oosaypp shaakkii tana beezoba; taakka ta ammana ta oosor nena beezoda» yeegiza.
Neenii, pettii Xoossii yezana ammaniza; yey yesse. Tuna ayyanitaykka ammaniza; yashshar kukkuriza.
Neno boozayo! Ammano oosopp shaakinttii yhayqqo maaqqeezana erodayis koyinnee?
Nu aday Afraame, fa na7a Isaaqa yarshsho aqol afa gaddeez wode xilleezay fa oosor baasa?
E ammanannee e oosay wolla ootheezannee e ammanay oosor polintteezana bo7oosaa?
Geeshsha Maxaafay, «Afraame Xooss ammaneeza. Xoossay yeya ezis xillotithi udii taybeeza» geezay polintteeza. Ma E Xooss dabbo ginttinttii xeegintteeza.
Asii ammano aaddar baazin oosor xillizana ne bi7inee.
Yey garkke, wushumizana Ra7aaba Isra7eelepp kiitintteezita mokkii hara oger unttan moyzeez wode fa oosor xillekkasa?
Shemppopp shaakintteez ashay yhayqqo maaqqeezay garkk, oosopp shaakintteez ammanaykka yhayqqeezbazii.
